steps.title: Accept/Decline Sessions

audioNote.markdown:
There are 5 session statuses: Accepted, Accept Queue, Pending, Decline Queue, and Declined.

Accepted is assigned to sessions that have been officially approved and will be included in the event. 

Accepted Queue sessions have been recommended or are being held for acceptance, but not yet finalized.

Pending is the default status for newly submitted sessions. These sessions are awaiting review or a decision.

Declined Queue is assigned to sessions that are being considered for rejection, but have not yet been officially marked as declined.

Declined sessions have been officially rejected and will not be included in the event.

Watch the Session Settings training video to learn how to create custom statuses.

steps.title: Session Statuses

audioNote.markdown: Session statuses are visible to speakers and submitters within the portal. However, sessions in Accept Queue or Decline Queue will display a pending icon without showing the specific status name. These queue statuses are typically used by teams that prefer to notify speakers of their session outcomes via email before the status becomes visible in the portal.

steps.title: Change Status

audioNote.markdown: Alternatively, you can update statuses in bulk. Simply check the box next to each session you’d like to update, then click the Edit button at the top of the page and select the desired status from the list of actions.
